2D WOVEN CARBON FABRIC

Wide range of weave patterns and constructions
for diverse composite applications.

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

FTC 2D woven carbon fabrics are available in plain, twill, diamond and hybrid constructions with multiple carbon, Kevlar and glass yarn combinations.

The product range covers lightweight 1.5K constructions through heavier 12K fabrics, supporting different stiffness, drape, appearance and processing requirements.

Standard products are supplied in 50 cm or 100 cm widths depending on construction, and other specifications can be customized based on request.
